newsitem.title: USA: Skyline Chili says Meritage withdraws offer.
newsitem.headline: Skyline Chili says Meritage withdraws offer.

text.p: Cincinnati-based restaurant chain Skyline Chili Inc said on Wednesday that Meritage Hospitality Group Inc had withdrawn its April 15 offer to acquire the company.
Skyline said it would continue evaluating strategic alternatives. No reason for the withdrawal was given in the statement, and no-one was available for comment at Skyline.
Meritage's previously announced offer had two options. One was to merge with Skyline, the other was a purchase of new shares equal to a majority of the enlarged Skyline stock.
Either option was said to be worth $9.50 per share to outside shareholders of Skyline based on then-prevailing share prices.
No trades in either Skyline stock or Meritage were reported on Wednesday. Skyline closed on Tuesday at 7-3/8, and Meritage at 4-1/2. (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712))
